name: pc_file_hash
description: Compute a bounded file hash (maximum 64 MB).

name: pc_compare_files
description: Compare file contents and hashes; each file must be at most 64 MB.

name: pc_file_head
description: Read the first lines of a UTF-8 file, up to 1 MB.

name: pc_file_tail
description: Read the last lines of a UTF-8 file, up to 1 MB.

name: pc_find_text
description: Find literal text in one UTF-8 file with line numbers and bounded matches.

name: pc_replace_text
description: Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 file atomically. expectedOccurrences prevents unintended edits.

name: pc_insert_lines
description: Insert UTF-8 text before a 1-based line in an existing file; EOF+1 appends.

name: pc_delete_lines
description: Delete an inclusive 1-based line range from an existing UTF-8 file.

name: pc_detect_encoding
description: Detect UTF BOMs, valid UTF-8 or unknown/binary data in a file of at most 1 MB.

name: pc_directory_summary
description: Summarize file counts, sizes and extensions; skips links and caps traversal at 5,000 entries.

name: pc_directory_tree
description: Read a bounded directory tree with relative paths; skips links.

name: pc_find_duplicates
description: Find identical files under a directory by size and SHA-256. Hashes at most 128 MB total.

name: pc_json_read
description: Read a JSON document as structured data, up to 1 MB.

name: pc_json_format
description: Return formatted JSON text without changing the source file.

name: pc_json_validate
description: Validate JSON syntax; reports parse errors without changing the file.

name: pc_json_query
description: Read a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901); an empty pointer selects the document.

name: pc_json_set
description: Atomically set a JSON Pointer value; the parent must exist. Empty pointer replaces the document.

name: pc_json_delete
description: Atomically remove a JSON Pointer key or array element; cannot delete the document root.

name: pc_json_merge
description: Atomically deep-merge an object into a JSON document; arrays are replaced.

name: pc_json_diff
description: Compare two JSON files structurally and return up to 500 changed JSON Pointers.

name: pc_csv_preview
description: Read raw CSV headers and a bounded row preview; supports quoted fields and multiline cells.

name: pc_csv_info
description: Report CSV shape, headers and ragged-row counts; maximum 20,000 rows and 256 columns.

name: pc_csv_filter
description: Return CSV rows matching a literal column filter; does not modify the file.

name: pc_csv_sort
description: Return CSV rows sorted by a named column; leaves the source unchanged.

name: pc_csv_select_columns
description: Return selected CSV columns in the requested order without changing the file.

name: pc_csv_to_json
description: Convert CSV rows to JSON objects with unique headers; returns a bounded preview.

name: pc_json_to_csv
description: Convert a JSON array of flat objects to CSV text without writing a file.

name: pc_git_status
description: Read repository short status, including branch and untracked files. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_diff
description: Read a bounded Git diff with external diff/textconv disabled. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_log
description: Read recent commit hashes, dates and subjects. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_branches
description: List local branches and their current commit. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_remotes
description: Read configured Git remote URLs without contacting them. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_show_file
description: Read a repository-relative file at a revision; no external textconv. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_ls_files
description: List tracked repository files. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_blame
description: Read bounded line attribution for a repository-relative file. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_stash_list
description: Read stash names and subjects without applying anything. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_tags
description: List up to 500 local tags. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_head
description: Read the current commit and repository root. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_git_check_ignore
description: Explain ignore rules for one repository-relative path. Runs Git read-only with hooks/fsmonitor/external diff disabled.

name: pc_text_stats
description: Count UTF-8 lines, words, characters, bytes and newline styles in a bounded file.

name: pc_text_normalize
description: Return normalized line endings and optional trailing-space removal; source remains unchanged.

name: pc_text_duplicate_lines
description: Find repeated nonempty lines with bounded counts and line numbers.

name: pc_markdown_headings
description: Extract Markdown ATX and setext headings outside fenced code blocks with line numbers.

name: pc_file_byte_sample
description: Read a bounded binary slice as hexadecimal and base64.

name: pc_directory_recent_files
description: List recently modified files under a directory, skipping links.

name: pc_file_exists
description: Check whether a path exists and report its type and size without failing when absent.

name: pc_file_lines
description: Read an inclusive 1-based line range from a UTF-8 file.

name: pc_text_between
description: Extract the text between the first start marker and the following end marker.

name: pc_search_text
description: Search text inside files under a folder. Skips binary files, links and oversized files.

name: pc_find_largest_files
description: List the largest files under a folder, with a minimum byte filter.

name: pc_list_extensions
description: Count files and bytes per extension under a folder.

name: pc_disk_space
description: Report total, free and available bytes for the volume holding a path.

name: pc_env_vars
description: List environment variable names, optionally with values. Values may contain secrets, so this always asks in unusual mode.

name: pc_which
description: Resolve a command name against PATH and report matching executables.

name: pc_network_interfaces
description: List local network interfaces and addresses.

name: pc_process_list
description: List running processes (pid and name), bounded and filtered.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring for the process name.

name: pc_dns_lookup
description: Resolve a hostname to its addresses.

name: pc_port_probe
description: Check whether a TCP port accepts connections on a host.

name: pc_http_get
description: Fetch an http(s) URL as UTF-8 text with redirects, size and time bounds. Always considered unusual.

name: pc_regex_extract
description: Run a bounded regular expression against a file and return matches and capture groups.

name: pc_markdown_links
description: List inline and automatic links from a Markdown file, ignoring fenced code.

name: pc_markdown_toc
description: Build a Markdown table of contents from a file's headings, ignoring fenced code.

name: pc_json_paths
description: List every JSON Pointer in a document with its value type.

name: pc_json_flatten
description: Flatten a JSON document to pointer/value pairs for scalar leaves.

name: pc_csv_group
description: Group CSV rows by a column and aggregate a numeric column.

name: pc_csv_distinct
description: List distinct values and counts for one CSV column.

name: pc_csv_row_lookup
description: Find CSV rows where a column equals or contains a value.

name: pc_diff_files
description: Compare two UTF-8 files line by line and report changed regions.

name: pc_text_replace_regex
description: Replace regular-expression matches in a file atomically, requiring the expected match count.

name: pc_text_sort_lines
description: Sort the lines of a file in place atomically.

name: pc_text_dedupe_lines
description: Remove duplicate lines in place, keeping the first occurrence.

name: pc_json_merge_into
description: Deep-merge one JSON document into another and write the destination atomically.

name: pc_write_bytes
description: Replace an existing file with decoded base64 bytes, up to 2 MB.

name: pc_touch_path
description: Update a path's access and modification times to now.

name: pc_truncate_file
description: Truncate an existing file to a smaller byte length.

bytes.description: New length in bytes; must be smaller than the current size.

name: pc_remove_empty_directory
description: Remove a directory only when it is empty.

name: pc_git_show_commit
description: Show one commit with metadata and a diffstat.

revision.description: Commit or rev, e.g. HEAD or a hash.

name: pc_git_reflog
description: List recent HEAD reflog entries.

name: pc_git_config
description: List effective Git configuration with origins.

name: pc_git_worktrees
description: List the repository worktrees in porcelain form.

name: pc_git_count_objects
description: Report repository object and pack counts.

name: pc_git_ahead_behind
description: Compare a revision with its upstream and report ahead/behind counts.

name: pc_git_shortlog
description: Summarise commit counts per author.

name: pc_git_ls_tree
description: List every tracked file at a revision.

name: pc_git_grep
description: Search tracked files with Git grep, bounded by max-count.

fixed.description: Treat the pattern as a fixed string.
